purpose: block ordering the single assembled R2-EVT1 prototype until current hardware release evidence and the recoverable first-spin firmware package have exhausted the inexpensive pre-order checks

procurement_boundary.factory_role: deterministically fabricate, populate and assemble the released package, including mating the exact documented production display and specified final-assembly parts
procurement_boundary.factory_powered_function_test: optional quote-only insurance and never a release prerequisite
procurement_boundary.first_full_power_on: owner after delivery under the reviewed current-limited bring-up procedure

current_truth.target_architecture: H0-R2 reviewed for six domains; ownership, working pin budgets, safety and HW/FW boundaries are current
current_truth.mechanical_projection: H1-R2.37 is the user-accepted reviewed dimensioned physical result; machine geometry is clean, and H1 does not authorize ECAD or ordering
current_truth.current_ecad: H2-R2.0.1 live mux route and H2-R2.0.2 exact detector/latch/release implementation are reviewed; H2-R2.0.3 Pack/Safety powered-off-Ioff closure is current. Native R2 production schematic export and PCB layout have not begun, and the archived R1 ECAD is historical and must not be built
current_truth.virtual_electrical: R2 routed-value electrical verification is blocked on current H2 and H6; historical R1 H3 evidence is not R2 order authority
current_truth.executable_firmware: F2-R2.5 is in progress for six production-SDK targets; the first-spin diagnostic, current R2 BSP import and recovery bundle are not reviewed
current_truth.instruction_emulation: F3-R2 and F-PO remain blocked; historical S3 QEMU evidence cannot prove the current R2 peripherals, PCB or non-S3 execution
current_truth.joined_release: R2 H4 joined review, H5 exact sourcing, H6 routed release candidate and immutable P8 order release have not run

required_evidence: current six-domain capability and safety scope
one owner and recoverable service path for every function
working pin, transport and resource budgets
hash-bound cross-repository HW/FW boundary
user-accepted dimensioned external and direct-view internal mockups
exact documented production display identity, electrical map, controlled drawing and mating envelope
exact documented bodies or controlled reserves
zero body, fastener, silkscreen, antenna, cable, accessory and opposing-face collisions
deterministic assembly, service access and enclosure load paths
current R2 symbols, contacts, nets, values, protections and exact footprints
the H1-selected production display rather than a donor-only legacy endpoint
zero unexplained ERC errors
machine parity with H0/H1 and exported six-domain BSP
independent power, reset, boot, recovery, quiet-state and no-back-power review
worst-case DC, startup, shutdown, source transition and load-step analysis
power, thermal, watchdog and fault-tree analysis
digital timing, USB and inter-domain electrical review
display, audio, IR, RF corridor and coexistence constraints
one current H1/H2/H3/firmware review
zero virtual blocker
every irreducible physical uncertainty assigned to owner bring-up or HIL
live stock, quantity-one price and factory route recheck for the H1-selected production display
current JLCPCB Standard PCBA route or explicit approved external route for every BOM line
MOQ, quantity-one cost, attrition and no-silent-substitution rules
written factory acceptance of every manual/final-assembly operation
reviewed placement and routing for both boards and the display adapter
DRC/ERC plus schematic-to-PCB net, footprint, courtyard and fitted-option parity
routed power, thermal, digital SI, return-path, USB, RF isolation and extracted-parasitic re-analysis
mechanical STEP, stack, cable, swept-volume and enclosure review
independent DFM and CPL-orientation review
F-PO FPO1-FPO7 reviewed against the exact H2/H6 candidate hashes
six reproducible diagnostic images
S3 QEMU and host/fake-HAL UI, control, missing-device and fault evidence
six-domain flash/recovery bundle and current-limited owner bring-up script
P0 through P7 complete on one coherent revision
hash-locked Gerber, drill, BOM, CPL, STEP, schematic, firmware and assembly instructions
exactly one finished assembled-device quote with factory attrition itemized
no silent substitution and owner approval of the final files and exact-one total

order_rules.rfq_without_commitment: may be requested to close sourcing and assembly feasibility
order_rules.engineering_samples: no separate display donor or speculative sample basket is a prerequisite
order_rules.factory_fct: optional only; design correctness must not depend on a paid factory powered test
order_rules.assembled_devices: exactly one R2-EVT1 after P8 release
order_rules.kicad: R2 schematic begins only after accepted H1; routing begins only after P4/P5 inputs are current
